description: Existing order in the declared user's Order History with a line of the given product type (with add-ons and personalization) whose product is still active and in stock, so Reorder copies it to the cart. KB: Create an Order from the Storefront (Option C: Reorder); My Account Dashboard.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the order: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username

productType.description: Product type the test adds: simple, configurable, bundle or grouped

quantityUsed.description: Highest quantity the test sets for this product in the cart

minAddOns.description: Add-on groups the test selects on this product (0 when it selects none)

minPersonalizableAttributes.description: Personalizable text attributes the test fills in (0 when none)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
